title: AIOPS2 | Dynamic Traces Explorer
description: Tempo TraceQL search and trace correlation readiness.

options.content: Tempo is configured as a datasource. The TraceQL search below returns only **ingested spans**. No trace is synthesized. Use Grafana Explore for trace waterfall and span details.

panels.title: Distributed trace search
panels.description: TraceQL search; Grafana Tempo datasource must be loaded and contain spans.

options.content: To filter by incident/run/scenario, instrument OpenTelemetry span attributes `incident.id`, `run.id`, `scenario.id`, `deployment.environment`, and `service.name`. Trace-to-logs needs matching trace IDs in Loki.
